notes.title: Roadmap and Post-Release Content
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here is our roadmap for "MOLC's Daily Life of S.P.R.I.T.E.S."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36800912/d22b47e4e1023e96d2f779a1aa38db0475bee3e8.jpg[/img]

We've been working hard on this game for over 2 years at this point and always planning ahead on future content releases. Finally, behold the UWU1, our new and evolutionary update cycle system. For the first updates we are trying to polish the main game mechanics we had planned but haven't smoothed out enough yet, so watch out for a lot of very exciting content that will be included in the first couple of months (All free updates, of course...)

We are also planning on further UWUs, and as the community keeps growing we hope to add content based on your wishes. Hey, if you are reading this feel free to post what you'd like to see in MOLC's Life of S.P.R.I.T.E.S. right now! If we can get enough inquiries we may even plan a Possible Update Poll Pre-Yesterevening, also known as a PUPPY.
